ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that the line segment $AB=12\, \text{cm}$, point $C$ is on the line segment $AB$, $AC=2BC$, then how many centimeters is $BC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Let $BC=x\, \text{cm}$, then $AC=2x\, \text{cm}$,\\
$x+2x=12$,\\
solving for $x$, we get: $x=4$,\\
$\therefore BC=\boxed{4}\, \text{cm}$.
